Le Mans Update 🇫🇷
CIRCUIT DE LA SARTHE OUT NOW!

On The Limit Racing 2 is a racing experience focused on realism, atmosphere, and the joy of driving. Drive highly detailed, realistic car models and explore a selection of fictional and real world circuits where smooth inputs, car control, and track knowledge matter most.

Dynamic weather systems bring each session to life.  As you drive, avoid the grass otherwise your car can get dirty adding a sense of immersion and realism to every lap. Whether you’re cruising, learning a circuit, or pushing for cleaner, faster laps, each run feels grounded and authentic.
